NVIDIA

If you’re a dedicated gamer, then one of the most important tools in your arsenal is a graphics card. To get your games looking and running at their absolute best, you need to have the right hardware, and NVIDIA cards are some of the best on the market. Since 1999, they’ve been working to enhance the gaming experience for players all over the world, thanks to their extensive range of graphics cards and other hardware solutions. NVIDIA has traditionally been at the forefront of developments in the world of graphics, with many of their newer cards supporting tech such as ray tracing and Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS). But importantly, they handle the most important job that you need a high-end graphics card for — getting your games looking great and running smoothly on your monitor.
 

So, if you’re looking to level up your gaming rig, it’s time to start looking at our selection of NVIDIA video cards. Able to cater for anyone from casual gamers to the most dedicated diehards, our selection of NVIDIA products will help get you up and running. And the team at Scorptec is here to help you get the setup that you need.
 

Buy NVIDIA graphics cards online with Scorptec today
As industry specialists for more than two decades, Scorptec is one of the leading online retailers for components in Australia. In addition to our great range of NVIDIA video cards and other graphics, we also offer PC hardware, components, peripherals, software, accessories, along with a range of other services. So no matter what sort of equipment you need to take your gaming rig to the next level, get in touch with Scorptec today.
 

FAQs
How do I choose the right NVIDIA graphics card?
When you’re looking to buy NVIDIA graphics cards, it’s important to consider how much you plan to game, which features interest you, what sort of CPU power you have and your monitor. There’s no point in splashing cash on an absolute top-of-the-line NVIDIA GPU if you have a monitor that caps out at 60hz and 1080p — you’re just needlessly wasting money. Similarly, you need to have a powerful CPU to get the most out of these cards; otherwise, your games will still chug, and your frame rate will suffer.

So, if you’re unsure about the best NVIDIA video card for you, make sure that you get in touch with the team here at Scorptec. As tech enthusiasts and gamers ourselves, we’ll be able to provide you with the advice you need in order to upgrade your machine to the specs you want.
 

Which types of NVIDIA graphics cards do you stock?
Here at Scorptec, we stock an extensive range of NVIDIA graphics cards from ASUS, Galax, Gigabyte, MSI, Palit, PNY and ZOTAC. Including RTX 3050, RTX 4060, RTX 4060 Ti, RTX 4070, RTX 4070 Super, RTX 4070 Ti Super, RTX 4080 Super, RTX 4090, RTX 5070 Ti, RTX 5080, RTX 5090 and more. Explore our full range right here online today!
 

What is NVIDIA RTX?
NVIDIA RTX is the most advanced platform for ray tracing and AI technologies that are revolutionising the ways we place and create. Three main areas — 4K play, ray tracing and Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS).
•    4K play is still something of a non-issue for many gamers, given the expense involved in monitors at present. However, it may be worth considering for gamers looking to futureproof their machines.
•    “Ray tracing” essentially means that the graphics card can model light sources and light movement in-game more effectively than normal rendering. Though it’s not currently compatible with every game on the market, it is likely to become more common with future AAA title releases.
•    Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS) essentially applies machine learning in-game, smoothing out rough edges and creating a more streamlined visual experience. It’s rather akin to traditional anti-aliasing, except it’s far less memory-intensive — often an important consideration for when CPU resources are at a premium.

At present, the results will likely be incremental as opposed to revolutionary for the average player. However, these are factors worth considering if you’re planning to be using your machine for several years to come.
